paras: Epibator greeri, also known commonly as Greer's tree skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to New Caledonia.
The specific name, greeri, is in honor of Australian herpetologist Allen Eddy Greer.
The preferred natural habitat of E. greeri is forest, at altitudes from 150–500 m (490–1,640 ft).
